mapper.select: SELECT A.USER_ID ,A.PW ,A.USER_NM ,A.DESK_DIV ,A.EMAIL ,A.HP_NO ,A.ROLE ,A.POSITION ,A.MAIL_YN ,A.SMS_YN ,A.USE_YN ,A.USER_COLOR ,A.USER_AVATAR ,A.LANG ,A.DEFAULTPAGE ,B.MENU_NM ,A.USE_STA_DATE ,A.USE_END_DATE ,TO_CHAR(A.EXTENSION_DATE,'YYYY-MM-dd') AS EXTENSION_DATE ,TO_CHAR(A.EMPLOYMENT_DATE,'YYYY-MM-dd') AS EMPLOYMENT_DATE ,A.CREATE_USER ,A.CREATE_DATE ,A.MODIFY_USER ,A.MODIFY_DATE ,COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT FROM TB_M_USERINFO A LEFT JOIN TB_M_MENUCFG B ON A.DEFAULTPAGE = B.MENU_ID WHERE USER_ID = #{in_userId}
